notes.title: Car Dealership Simulator 2 – Development Update & Release Date
notes.content: [p][/p][h3][b]Hello everyone![/b][/h3][p]We’ve been quiet for a while, but during this time we’ve made significant progress on our game. With this update, we want to share the details of our new title, [b]Car Dealership Simulator 2[/b], and celebrate our excitement with you.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Big news: We’re launching on September 26th![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’ve expanded the map by adding new regions and made the gameplay smoother and more enjoyable. [/p][p]Each vehicle has been carefully crafted; we’ve enhanced their visual details with precision and improved their driving dynamics to deliver a more realistic and satisfying experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Even after release, we’ll continue updating the game with new cars, refined mechanics, and community-driven content shaped by your feedback. [/p][p][/p][p]With every update, our goal is to make the experience even more fun and fulfilling, while growing the game together by listening to our players’ requests and suggestions.[/p][p][/p][p]Join us on this journey by supporting the development of our game—[b]share your thoughts, comments, and feedback[/b] so we can take it even further together![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Our new gameplay trailer is live![/b][/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="vp8RJt316pI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]Don’t forget to like and comment on our trailer! Share your thoughts with us.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Here are some new in-game screenshots![/b][/h3][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42975423/6e38cdde4ce87af60604fdca82534df851e6325b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42975423/461c20c6985765f170934d737ef5d34434d2badf.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42975423/820da538bd9de64ce073124319a7e96ef4412b4c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42975423/a95cd9aa525f530706bf4a32e209a7a6c7a1c848.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42975423/94792edcc792244da5635ef8e11d3015ce3b3f06.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42975423/1a0c763ebe4fd9d0a0802afe3bc9e9b90baa70b3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42975423/b89d759f12ca3509c03e866df8b0ac29ef7c737e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Also, make sure to add our game to your Wishlist! Be the first to play it on release day and stay up to date with all the latest updates. Your support means the world to us![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Thank you for supports with us.[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Car Dealership Simulator 2 Announcement! Add it to your wishlist now!
notes.content: [p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576799/0b95cc3a4df2db262c3ac2c73af6cb595850c571.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576799/d5469f6f883493da167a95552ba0c477f2c0869f.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Hello everyone!👋[/b][/h3][p][b]We’re excited to introduce our new game, Car Dealership Simulator 2! Get ready for a vast open world and a fresh experience with detailed cars for every budget.[/b][/p][p][b]We’ve prepared this update to walk you through some exciting game mechanics and notable features, giving you a clear picture of how the game works and what it has to offer. Enjoy reading![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Steam Next Fest 📢💥[/b][/h3][p][b]⚠️"Our game is currently featured in Steam Next Fest! You can download the limited demo, try it out, and share any bugs or content suggestions you'd like to see added during development. Your support means a lot to us!"⚠️[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576799/3b662a01f18726f709c8bff3cdaf08ecf01bf270.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576799/ce79f0c4ff2c8c81c349781461d84dd9520dd984.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576799/d544c0c15117f4a4777d41921a00401e70ece7e8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Used car markets and dealerships will be located in specific areas on the map. Vehicles will be sold at dealerships by class, while used car markets offer affordable options for buying and selling. This lets you choose between new and used vehicles.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576799/a6033dd0efb207d68b66a7be3ccd29c219c72050.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Vehicles are classified into super sports, luxury, mid-range, and lower segment classes. Each class has its own dealerships, and some vehicles are also sold in used car markets according to these classes.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576799/682a22d22fc0ecb5c660b5e258d0f00765e64b63.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576799/43cb3df91b4cd656fdd5e8deaef486d6cf1524fb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576799/60fff5b44f727031329a39bcbc706a219cafb5ba.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Vehicles have basic features like acceleration and weight, plus unique details. Sports and luxury cars’ brake discs can heat up, while super sports cars have animated spoilers at high speeds. Interiors are detailed and realistic.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576799/93a218610331db67dce7cab5fd7a335a27cd1d6c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Customize your cars with visual mods like rims and paint to reflect your personal style.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576799/befce03c236efd3ab1a5fdac3ed81b01b8503755.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576799/f99a7fd59eba86c517820d2c7c52310d2a117be9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576799/ef01a8c3d70b22fb0ca9e7502bc46487c05b7eef.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]The game will feature NPCs in specific areas who give missions and can be interacted with. These characters offer tasks based on their content. In future updates, we plan to expand this system with voice acting and more detailed dialogues.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576799/ee961dde8b31d90073ea4a5dd24679d3deaa51b8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576799/848155b42f97fd0360e9f1c2c272520ec77e6e82.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576799/4a12268436fb509d207b3ad469985948539f7530.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576799/1ba8381c8a55e52d52b19866c92aaeaf92091659.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576799/9711bae0ba790fd62c4b6e953ec5a8451905682b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]The game will feature not only vehicles but also purchasable car sales shops, houses, and various properties. These assets allow players to expand their in-game investments and living spaces.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]⭐As development continues, we’ll keep sharing updates about the new content added to the game. After the demo, we’ll announce many of the new features we’ve been working on in upcoming posts.‼️[/u][/b][/p][h3][/h3][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576799/ba854ae4db1a68bbfcf5a373834b12f11f6a1c02.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3616550/Car_Dealership_Simulator_2/"][/dynamiclink][/h3][p][b]Don’t forget to add Car Dealership Simulator 2 to your wishlist and follow us to stay updated on all the latest developments![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45576799/2eaf05b3f352bf72a1904f922a7269b20961e67a.jpg"][/img][/p]

[b]You can support us by adding our upcoming game to your wish list![/b]

[b]Dealer Simulator[/b], invites you to a world where your bargaining skills will be tested to the limits, and you'll never know what lies behind each door. Are you ready to become a top-tier trader? Join the warehouse adventure with Dealer Simulator!

[list]
[*] Realistic Open World.
[*] Realistic item and vehicle physics.
[*] Take full control of your shop. Shop interior design, store location, customer numbers, and much more.
[*] More than 5 drivable vehicle options.
[*] Over 400 item varieties. (We keep adding new models, and this number may increase in our future update notes.)
[*] Bargaining skills.

notes.title: Car Dealership Simulator 0.4 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone!

Car Dealership Simulator 0.4 Update
[/h3]

[h2]Important!![/h2]
[list]
[*] Question: Is my save file broken in this update?
[*] Answer: Yes.
[*] Question: Will my save file continue to get broken as the game receives updates?
[*] Answer: Yes, your save files will be broken as new content is added to the game. Because the newly added features do not match your save files. Thank you for your understanding!![/list]


[h3][Fixes][/h3]
- There was a save error in a vehicle, fixed.
- There were bugs in car gallery upgrades, fixed.

[h3][Content][/h3]
- Added 11 new vehicles.
- Added online vehicle purchase.
- Added change player vehicle.
- Part paint control system has been added to vehicles purchased from the internet.
- Added 2 new car gallery upgrades.
- Car parks has been increased to 15.
- Tax added to vehicles.
- Added luxury vehicle buy place.
- Car wash model has been changed.

notes.title: Car Dealership Simulator 0.2 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone!

Car Dealership Simulator 0.2 Update[/h3]

[h3](Save file may be broke when the update. Please start new game.)[/h3]

[h3][Fixes and Content][/h3]
- Work time has been changed. (10:00-17:00)
- Customer waiting time has been increased.
- Fixed an error when entering the gallery name on the computer screen.
- Fixed the gallery upgrade button disappearing when there was no money.
- Fixed the viewing distance on the computer screen.
- The washing times of the vehicles have been accelerated.
- Added "eat" and "drink" text on food and drinks.
- New garage added. (New upcoming works will also be here.)
- Added tire changing mechanics.
- Added tea brewing mechanics. 
- Added 3 new cars.
- A warning message has been added that you cannot change vehicle prices while the shop is open.
- The street lamp was added.
